main_text.p: Ad raporum quoque catalogum refertur napus & rapunculus feu rapum fylueftre.

Napus radices habet prælongas, tres fere palmos in terram defcendentes craffitudine ftaphylino luteo pares, in cibo propter infi-gnem dulcedinem gratiffimæ, fuaues ac falu-bres, præfertim cum carnibus præcipuè fuil-lis & veruecina coctæ, has enim mita fuaui-tate condiunt: fi quis vero flatuum prouen-tum ex crudo illarum fucco pertimefcat, is ex finapi coctas edat, hoc enim modo flatus diffipabuntur. Sabulo in fubterraneis cellis incorruptæ feruantur, durant enim fic con-ditæ in multos menfes. Has eduntex butyro in Papatu, diebus quibus carne vefci vetitum eft, præfertim ieiunio illo quadragenario.

Rapunculus rapum exiguum feu mini-mum napi genus, eftur vere in acetariis. Sed tenendum vfum huius ante primum ver effe noxium, frigore fcilicet terræ meatibus ad-huc occlufis, foliisq; nondum apparenter e-rumpentibus: vere quoque tepido & humi-do, certum eftefum huius minus falutarem effe. Videant igitur, qui liberalius eo vtuntur. Cocta radix cum planta guftui in acetariis magis arridet, minusque eft noxia, quamque in terræ vifceribus malignitatem contraxit, eam coctionis vi amittit.

page.notes: Left margin notes: "Rapuncu", "li vfus in acetariis", "noxius" are marginal catchwords, transcribed as printed in the margin where legible; the lower-left "De" is a signature-like fragment and was not treated as text. The line "amittit." is printed in the main text. Several words in the margin are damaged and uncertain; the margin entries are approximate. The page scan is slightly skewed and the lower third has faint show-through, which was not transcribed.
